Bond depreciation discourages hoarding: each bond, bought for 120 units and locked 10 epochs, typically loses 4% per epoch unless real work restores it.
An attacker seeking to forge 1,000 identities commits 120,000; the summit of cost arrives when idle bonds fall below 60, losing privileges.
Confirmed fraud forfeits 50% of residual value and freezes renewal 6 epochs, so 1,000 idle clones, whose beacon fades each epoch, lose 40,000 in 10 epochs.
